brick-house--classic.description: Julius Newman named Brick House in 1937 after the brick home where he was born in a Hungarian village; his grandsons Eric and Bobby revived it more than eighty years later. Made at J.C. Newman's PENSA factory in Estelí, it wraps Nicaraguan binder and filler in an Ecuadorian Havana leaf, and moves from spice and nuts through dark fruit and wood to a lightly sweet finish.

thirds.notes: Spice and nuts lead, with licorice and fig-like sweetness underneath.
Dark fruit, nuts and wood take over as the smoke turns creamy.
Licorice and spice return, softened by a little sweetness from the wrapper.

sources.title: J.C. Newman – Brick House Robusto review

brick-house--maduro.description: Brick House Maduro shares the Classic's Nicaraguan binder and filler, rolled at J.C. Newman's PENSA factory in Estelí, but dresses them in a dark, fermented Brazilian Arapiraca wrapper. Full in strength and body, it smokes dark and spicy, with a natural sweetness drawn from the wrapper, and comes in four sizes up to the 70-ring Commodore.

brick-house--double-connecticut.description: The gentlest Brick House layers a Connecticut Shade wrapper over a Connecticut Broadleaf binder, with the line's Nicaraguan filler at its core, and is made at J.C. Newman's PENSA factory in Estelí. Mild in strength yet full of flavour, it carries notes of spice and pepper and is made in six sizes, from Robusto to Churchill.

brick-house--bricktoberfest.description: A limited seasonal Brick House, Bricktoberfest is a 7¾ x 48 Churchill with a pigtail cap, an Ecuadorian Havana Rosado wrapper and a Nicaraguan blend inside, rolled at J.C. Newman's PENSA factory in Estelí. Medium in strength, it was blended to go with a bold, malty Oktoberfest-style lager and comes in boxes of ten with a secondary band.
